data.one_liner: Flutter SDK for sending analytics events to Aptabase
data.what_it_does: Aptabase provides a privacy‑first analytics backend. The Flutter SDK lets you manually track events and send them to Aptabase, with offline storage and automatic metadata enrichment.
use_when: You need a lightweight, cross‑platform analytics solution that respects privacy
You want manual control over which events are sent
You need offline event queuing and retry logic
avoid_when: You require automatic event tracking or deep integration with navigation or state management
You need a full‑fledged analytics platform with automatic session handling
strengths: Cross‑platform support (Android, iOS, macOS, Linux, Windows, Web)
Privacy‑first design with no automatic data collection
Offline event queuing and retry logic
weaknesses: No automatic lifecycle or navigation tracking
data.setup_notes: Add package, run flutter pub add aptabase_flutter, add INTERNET permission on Android, call WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized() and await Aptabase.init("<APP_KEY>") in async main
